key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the relay unit state and statistics are re-read in the background, in addition to change signals and opening Quick Settings. Never less than 30 seconds.

key.name: show-balance
key.description: Show the Nostr Wallet Connect balance from org.nostr.Wallet1. The balance is only read automatically when nostr-wallet-agent already allows GNOME Shell to read the wallet; the panel never triggers an approval prompt on its own.

key.name: show-dm-status
key.description: Show whether nostr-notify.service is delivering direct-message notifications. nostr-notify exposes no unread count yet.
